title: Understanding the True Model
text: In the context of the problem, the true model is represented by the function $$f_{\theta} x$$. This model is used to generate the observed response vector Y from the design matrix X.

title: Role of Theta*
text: Theta* is a parameter in the true linear model $$f_{\theta} x$$. It is used to generate the true response values Y from the design matrix X.

title: Fixed or Variable?
text: Consider whether theta* changes during the generation of X and Y, or if it remains constant throughout the process.

title: Theta* in the True Model
text: Is theta* a fixed quantity in the true model used to generate X and Y?
